subject: Update on projector signal
text: Thanks so much for your last message, that made things much clearer. I tried the steps you suggested during the community fair setup, and the projector still loses signal every few minutes when the laptop wakes from sleep. The cable seems fine, but I noticed a loose port that may need a replacement adapter before Saturday. Could you take a quick look when you have a spare moment? If you want, I can swap the presentation laptop with the spare one from the office cabinet so we do not risk another dropout while doors open. I can also test the newer HDMI adapter you mentioned, though I might need a tiny screwdriver to fit it securely. I really appreciate your patience, especially with the venue running behind this week and all of us chasing loose ends at once today.
